regions.title: Cascades
regions.text: Mt. Baker is forecast for about 63". Crystal Mountain and Stevens Pass follow. The National Weather Service has rain mixed in at Mt. Baker Thursday night. Winter Weather Advisory at Mt. Baker from Monday night to Tuesday night.

regions.title: Coast Mountains
regions.text: Whistler is forecast for about 63". Cypress Mountain follows. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Whistler Tuesday.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 25", 14" of it Friday. Jackson Hole and Big Sky follow.

regions.title: Northeast
regions.text: Blue Mountain is forecast for about 21", 13" of it Friday. Jay Peak and Stowe follow. Environment Canada has rain mixed in at Blue Mountain Friday and Friday night. Snow Squall Warning at Blue Mountain from Tuesday.

regions.title: Kootenays
regions.text: Whitewater is forecast for about 19", 10" of it Thursday. RED Mountain and Revelstoke follow.

regions.title: Okanagan
regions.text: Big White is forecast for about 18". SilverStar and Sun Peaks follow.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Steamboat is forecast for about 7", 4" of it Saturday. Telluride and Aspen Highlands follow.

sources.name: NOAA buoys 51001 / 51101 (method: Powder Buoy, Mike Ruzek)

buoy.text: Buoys 51001 and 51101 near Hawaii popped Nov 11, the swell signal Powder Buoy watches for a Wasatch storm about two weeks later — here Nov 22–28. In past winters a pop raised the chance of a Wasatch storm in that window by roughly 6 to 12 points. Experimental: promising, not proven.
